items.summary: Zodl just made IP shielding a default for Zcash users, and it’s part of a wider push in crypto to hide who’s behind transactions.

items.title: Phylax and Titan Bring Circuit Breakers to Ethereum
items.summary: Titan, which assembles about half of Ethereum's blocks, now checks transactions against apps' own safety rules before they settle.

items.title: Warren Puts Prediction Markets, Trump Crypto on Banking Agenda
items.summary: With Democrats retaking the Senate, crypto's loudest critic will set the agenda in January for the committee that oversees banks, the Fed and crypto.

items.title: Venice Sets a New VVV Burn Record
items.summary: Venice's latest monthly buyback-and-burn retired 21,657 VVV on Base, its biggest discretionary burn yet and about 10% above October's.
